player_characters.name: Jostin Joestar
player_characters.activity: in the alley outside Pulse Printworks, over the restrained sedan driver, Eagle Vision on him, relaying to the crew
player_characters.power: Stand I Fell In Love With Princess Peach (IFILWPP): absorbs, stores and redirects kinetic energy by contact. Techniques: Peach Python (kusarigama chain fed at the turning points), Peach Launcher Twin Volley (debris barrage), Peach Gearshift (converts potential and kinetic energy, self or touched; a full-power launch can tear muscle or break bone), Peach Assassination (non-lethal pressure-point sequences), Peach Limit Break (accelerated heartbeat, rising strain), Peach Healing, Peach Aftershock (leaves stored energy in an object, released at will), Peach Stillpoint: Redirect. Eagle Vision (hostile threats red, allies blue, key objects gold; reads hostility and tension, not thoughts or text), Phantom Waltz, Shadow Step (assassin training, no Peach), Blackstar Dominion (will as a pressure wave: calming to allies, crushing to enemies; independent of Peach; first t189), Hoshino Requiem (forbidden technique, named in play, details not recorded). Weakness: overuse tears muscle; cannot create force from nothing. Full engine text: docs/pc-sheets.md.
player_characters.background: Born into a clandestine, state-sanctioned assassin branch of the Joestar lineage (the heart-shaped birthmark high on his upper back is hereditary, not a tattoo; people who know the family may recognize it). Raised on surveillance, linguistics and lethal combat with kusarigama and hidden blade; survived 'the culling' (siblings and cousins forced to hunt one another). Late teens, tousled dark auburn hair, sharp amber eyes, a knowing smirk. Calls himself Diojo to Riko. Student at Chikara Academy.
player_characters.notes: Crew Head of Hearth (the home); co-owns Club Lumiere. Strategist and extraction specialist. Gear: padded kusarigama, throwing knives, hidden blade (taken at The House's stairs, but he has one again: drew it at t471). Killed Iori Vale when she was puppeted into his strike (t182; she had asked him to kill her if she turned; she died in his arms: Voyage journal t182 'companionDeath', settled at the t481 resync); told Aurelia and Rikona about the Joestar branch and the culling (Reiko heard only 'hands clean except mine'); rescued Shun, freed Daiki. Relationships: Ayame (kissed t425, owes her a date), Riko Amane (kissed t167), Rikona (trust). Power Strain 55/100, Energy 0/100 at t326 (stale). PC tests: love and home (never outcomes).

player_characters.name: Jovian Joestar
player_characters.activity: leaning on the alley wall, smoking, watching the perimeter
player_characters.power: Stand Breaker's Soul: spectral upper-body warrior of pure physical force (Breaker Limit, Breaker Limit Flush, Road Hog, Desperation Impact). Joestar Breathing forms: First Phantom Step, Second Heaven's Impact, Third Phantom Strike, Fourth Soul Eclipse, Fifth Falling Star Palm, Eleventh Soul Pierce; also played: Sixth Form Twin Soul, Thousand Fist Lotus, Zero Form Sovereign's Will (crushing pressure aura), Phantom Strike/Step. Weakness: his body pays for big releases (Soul Burn). Full engine text: docs/pc-sheets.md.
player_characters.background: Young Korean fighter, sharp features, tousled black hair, piercing dark eyes, lean muscular build. Grew up in the friction of Tokyo's streets: a known delinquent who learned to survive on improvisation and grit. Bears the hereditary heart-shaped Joestar birthmark on his upper back. Student at Chikara Academy.
player_characters.notes: Crew Head of Spearhead (the field), brawler; co-owns Club Lumiere. Gear: reinforced alloy knuckles (built by Hana). Won Round 1 (Iwao and Kiri) and Round 2 (Goro) at The House with Mikoto as 'Jovian and Friend of Course'; pinned Banda's wrist away from the spare syringe; beat Kaito Serizawa in the Thursday rematch; signed the disciplinary agreement with Anya. Relationships: Yuzuki (tea, taiyaki lessons; kissed t425), Mikoto (rivalry banter), Kaito Serizawa. Persuasion rose 5 to 6 (t435). PC tests: strength and purpose (never outcomes).
